statements.statement: The town manager requested a 2.5% increase for the school department.
The superintendent's level-service school budget is a 10.59% increase, about $2.4 million.
The gap between level service and a 2.5% increase for the schools is about 1.85 million.
A rough guess that an override might be 3 to 5 million, about 10% of the budget.
Health insurance increase came in at 5.7%, under the state average.

warnings.condition: if no override or infusion of money
warnings.prediction: If no infusion of money, students, town employees and the whole town will be affected; no one will be left harmless.

warnings.condition: if the override is set at the minimum
warnings.prediction: A minimum override will not hold for long and the town would be back within about three years.

warnings.condition: if other money is not found
warnings.prediction: Without finding savings, a firefighter, EMT, teacher or DPW worker may be laid off.
The school budget at 2.5% would force reductions across maintenance, custodians, teachers, guidance and social workers.

warning: EXTRACTED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL FROM MACHINE CAPTIONS. Every figure is as heard and may be misheard; every line carries the second in the video, which is the record.
